title: Hook-first high-speed double jump into full neon run

clips.why: Opens on top-speed dodging and consecutive orange barrier jumps at SPD 84-85
Shows clean lane-switching around a pink X block and collecting coins
Highlights barrier jumping with GREAT JUMP! feedback
Escalates with rapid multi-lane dodging and coin collection up to 156m
Demonstrates the free Revive mechanic after a crash to keep the run alive
Shows speed ramping from SPD 72 to 79 while weaving past a magnet power-up
Builds to high-speed reflex dodging through tight pink X formations
Displays final coin count and pulsing PLAY NOW call to action
